verdict.rationale: Runpod documents pre-configured Docker-image templates, including an official PyTorch template that removes manual setup of PyTorch, JupyterLab and dependencies. A community user confirms launching templates in a few clicks, and the docs describe pre-built vLLM workers for Serverless. The story's named CUDA and ComfyUI templates are not evidenced, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: evidence of CUDA and ComfyUI templates, documentation that vLLM is offered as a Pod template rather than only a Serverless worker, and a catalog of the available official templates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: you can select an official Runpod PyTorch template and have everything ready to go instantly
Instead of installing PyTorch, configuring JupyterLab, and setting up dependencies yourself, you can select a template and have everything ready instantly.
